subject: disttask: add local disk space to node resource managed by DXF (#59607)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (b45a9e840c5b0bcdecab71dbc0f9fef0923463c6) focusing on DDL/add-index + DXF(disttask) resource/metadata paths. Change introduces `proto.NodeResource` (CPU/mem/disk), computes it in `pkg/domain/domain.go` (CPU/mem with cgroup v2 adjustment; disk via `lightning/common.GetStorageSize(cfg.TempDir)` with fallback to `tidb_ddl_disk_quota`), and threads it into disttask scheduler/taskexecutor params. DDL backfill scheduler (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_scheduler.go`) now computes/logs per-task available local disk but does not yet enforce it. No Blocker/High correctness, data-consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or state-machine/metadata issues identified; later upstream/master history shows subsequent refactors but no indication of a post-merge fix for a Blocker/High issue in this area.
